purpose: Identify an event that initiates a significant new development.
keywords: N + を契機に / を契機として
The accident prompted a review of safety rules.
We used the relocation as an opportunity to replace the old equipment.
The international tournament led to wider exchanges.
formation: N + を契機に / を契機として
restrictions: Often used for organizational or substantial changes.
mistake: For a casual personal trigger, をきっかけに is often more natural.
